text:
Alex: Hey team — running into a procurement snag for the Acme POC. Customer needs an order form + countersigned MSA/DPA before we stand up the dedicated test capacity. They want net45 payment terms and an HSM/KMS clause in the DPA. Can legal/finance advise on routing?
Maria (Legal): Please attach the customer's redline. Quick flags: we usually push back on perpetual IP assignment language and on delegating audit rights to third parties. Net45 is ok if sales gets exec approval for the extension. Is this >$100k ARR?
Alex: Not that big — POC expected ~ $18k ARR if converted first year. Attaching their redline in thread (link pasted in convo). They also added: "Customer requires that logs be retained 5 years and that we allow on-site audits".
Sam (Security): On-site audits + 5y retention is a heavy ask. We can offer SOC2 attestation + audited third-party log retention evidence, but on-site audits need a controlled process (NDA + security scoping). For HSM/KMS: we support customer-managed keys in Private/Dedicated but that requires an add-on and a snippet in the order form. We'll need ENG to scope time for HSM onboarding. :thinking_face:
Tina (Finance): Net45 ok for POC but we need a PO number before provisioning. Procurement usually wants the final order form PDF and signed MSA/DPA. Also FYI: any payment term > net30 requires an approval ticket and a billing hold exception. Who will own the approval?
Maria (Legal): Alex, can you confirm which DPA template they redlined (our standard or a counterparty template)? If it's their template, we need to run a line-by-line and escalate the IP/audit/data location bits. For audits we can propose: "audit by certified third parties with 30 days notice, scoped to relevant logs" instead of unfettered on-site. Also we should add the standard KMS appendix if they're insisting on HSM.
Alex: They used their own DPA. I'll pull out the specific clauses. Planning to propose: 1) limited audit scope, 2) 1 year log retention (maybe 3?) and 3) KMS appendix w/ onboarding fee. Example order form snippet I plan to send: ```
Product: Redwood Dedicated - POC
Seat/Capacity: 1x A100 equivalence (30 days)
Price: $15,000 (one-time test fee) + $3,000/mo if extended
Payment terms: Net45 (PO required)
Add-ons: HSM / KM integration - $5,000 setup
```
DocuSign Bot: Envelope 0x9f34 sent to acme-poc@acme.com, status: sent.
Maria (Legal): That approach seems reasonable. On the IP clause: redline the assignment language to a license-back for Redwood (one-way license to operate the service). For SLA redlines — don't accept liquidated damages without Finance sign-off. Also add a clause: "Execution by electronic signature (DocuSign) is acceptable; wet-ink only if lawful requirement provided by customer."
Tina (Finance): If they insist on liquidated damages we need to quantify cap and run it by RevOps. Also escalate if total contract liability > $250k. Requesting billing contact and PO flow so we can pre-authorize invoicing.
Sam (Security): Quick technical note for the KMS appendix: we require a maintenance window and SSH-less key rotation. I'll paste the KMS onboarding checklist for ENG: ```
- Customer provides KMS access role + minimal encryption key policy
- Onboarding window: 2 business days
- Fallback: Redwood-managed key if onboarding delayed
```
Alex: Thanks. Action items: 1) I'll prepare a trimmed redline proposal (DPA + order form) and ping Maria for legal language, 2) Tina — please open the billing exception ticket for net45, assign to finance-approvals, 3) Sam — can you send the KMS checklist to eng-runtime for scoping?
Maria (Legal): I'll review the redline today. If we can convert the on-site audit into a scoped third-party audit + 30 days notice, I can clear DPA with standard KMS appendix. :thumbsup:
Tina (Finance): Ticket created: FIN-4521, owner: Tina. Please include PO contacts in the reply email.
Alex: Perfect. If DocuSign gets returned signed we can provision. If they refuse e-sign and demand wet-ink, we escalate to "exec exceptions" and it's slower — callout to sales ops.
DocuSign Bot: Recipient acme-poc@acme.com opened envelope 0x9f34 at 16:12 UTC.
Alex: Noted — I'm going to send the proposed redline now. Will @Maria (Legal) once it's uploaded. Thanks everyone! :pray:
